title: Verify geometry contracts and revision workflow
description: Verify pure geometry contracts and the visible create, revise, preview, reload, refusal, provenance, and immutable-history workflow required by PRD 15.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract checks cover unit parsing, bounded fractions, unique derivation, each refusal class, canonical fingerprints, and label-boundary coordinates
Equivalent metric and imperial fixtures produce equivalent normalized geometry and fingerprints
A browser flow creates a layout, discloses a derivation, saves it, revises geometry, and retains both revisions
Browser coverage proves invalid geometry is refused without a durable revision
Preview geometry and separate identity, provenance, and verification labels survive reload
All assertions use public pure contracts or user-visible browser behavior
Build, lint, unit/integration, and focused Playwright checks pass

steps.details: Create compact fixtures for valid metric and imperial equivalents, each derivation outcome, each refusal class, radius states, and changed/unchanged fingerprint cases.
Assert parser, derivation, validator, canonical encoder, fingerprint, and preview-primitive outputs without importing React or browser storage.
Create a layout through accessible controls, inspect derivation disclosure and preview, then enter invalid geometry and assert save refusal and associated errors.
Save a valid edit as a second revision, restart the browser context, and assert both immutable revisions, selected preview, fingerprint behavior, and disclosure labels.
Run build/type checking, lint, unit/integration tests, and the focused Playwright workflow; fix failures without weakening refusal or durability assertions.

technicalNotes: Keep browser assertions centered on labels, errors, headings, SVG outputs, and durable revision behavior.
Physical verification remains unproven even when software geometry contracts pass.
